name: banded-upright-row
instructions:
1. Stand on a band with both feet and grab one end with each hand.
2. Take a deep breath then pull the band high by driving your elbows high.
3. Slowly lower the handle back to the starting position under control.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
